meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: Claude 会把你给的一项任务拆成多个可独立合并的最小 PR；每个 PR 在独立工作目录里实现，做真实人工测试并留证据，再写英文 PR 说明，跑 CI 和 Cubic 审核，通过后自动合并并清理。任何一步失败都会回到修复再测试的循环，直到通过为止。
howto.when: 当你说出“create a PR”“implement and PR”“split into atomic PRs”等关键词，或要求“实现 issue”“以 PR 落地”时触发；语境暗示要 PR 交付时，直接说“implement X”也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 实现成 PR 并合并
say.note: 会拆成小 PR，逐个走完整流程。

say.text: 把这项改动拆成几个独立小 PR 并行推进
say.note: 每个 PR 独立工作目录，并发开发。

say.text: 帮我写英文 PR 说明，附上测试证据
say.note: 会先人工测试，再生成可读的英文 PR。

howto.what_en: Claude splits the task into minimal atomic PRs, implements each in its own worktree with manual QA evidence, creates an English PR, runs CI + Cubic verification, auto-merges, and cleans up. Failed gates loop back to fix and re-QA.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'split into atomic PRs', etc., ask to implement an issue, land work as a PR, or simply say 'implement X' when PR delivery is implied.

say_en.text: Implement this issue as a PR and merge it.
say_en.note: Will split into small PRs and run the full flow.

say_en.text: Split this change into small independent PRs and run them in parallel.
say_en.note: Each PR gets its own worktree and develops concurrently.

say_en.text: Write the English PR description with test evidence.
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then generates the English PR.
